description: A tenant is dealing with repeated late-night noise from a neighboring unit and needs to document incidents, track building responses, and decide when informal communication is no longer enough. All building names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 33-year-old graduate student who studies and works from home
user_profile.context: Several sleepless weeks have made the problem too disruptive to keep ignoring
user_profile.communication_style: Measured and factual, prefers keeping a clear record before escalating

fact_sheet.fact: The tenant's name is Elara Vance.
Elara Vance resides in Unit 4B at The Constellation Apartments.
Elara Vance is a 33-year-old Ph.D. candidate in Astrophysics at Stellar University.
The building is named The Constellation Apartments.
The Constellation Apartments is located at 1400 Nova Street, Aptos, CA 95003.
Elara Vance's lease for Unit 4B began on August 1, 2023.
The source of the noise is Unit 4A, which is directly adjacent to Elara Vance's unit.
The primary type of noise from Unit 4A is loud electronic music with heavy bass.
A secondary type of noise from Unit 4A includes frequent shouting and laughter from multiple individuals.
On January 12, 2024, loud electronic music emanated from Unit 4A between 1:30 AM and 3:45 AM.
On January 15, 2024, shouting and laughter from Unit 4A was audible from 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM.
On January 19, 2024, bass-heavy music from Unit 4A disturbed Elara Vance between 1:00 AM and 4:00 AM.
On January 26, 2024, loud party noise from Unit 4A occurred from 2:15 AM to 3:30 AM.
On February 2, 2024, sustained bass from Unit 4A was present from 1:00 AM to 2:45 AM.
On February 9, 2024, music and conversation from Unit 4A lasted from 12:30 AM to 3:00 AM.
On February 16, 2024, Elara Vance recorded bass thumping from Unit 4A between 1:45 AM and 3:15 AM.
On February 23, 2024, loud voices and music from Unit 4A were audible from 1:15 AM to 3:00 AM.
On March 1, 2024, a new incident of loud music and shouting from Unit 4A occurred from 1:00 AM to 2:30 AM.
Elara Vance left a polite, handwritten note on Unit 4A's door on January 20, 2024, requesting quiet after 11 PM.
The informal note did not result in a reduction of late-night noise from Unit 4A.
Elara Vance is documenting all noise incidents in a Google Sheet titled 'Noise Log - Unit 4B'.
The Google Sheet includes columns for 'Date', 'Start Time', 'End Time', 'Noise Type', and 'Duration (minutes)'.
Audio recordings of noise incidents are being captured on Elara Vance's smartphone and backed up to cloud storage.
Elara Vance has experienced an average of 3-4 hours of sleep disruption per week due to the noise.
The property management company for The Constellation Apartments is 'Aurora Property Group'.
The primary contact for Aurora Property Group is Property Manager Leo Thorne, reachable at manager@aurorapg.com.
The official noise complaint policy states quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM daily.
Elara Vance plans to submit a formal written complaint to Aurora Property Group via email on March 4, 2024, if the noise continues.

user_needs.description: From which unit is the noise coming, and what types of noise are they?
What are the dates, times, and types of noise for the most recent incidents I've logged in February and March?
What methods am I using to document the noise incidents?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After reviewing the logged incidents, the user may want to confirm the methods used for documentation to ensure they are robust.

user_needs.description: When and how did I first attempt to communicate with my neighbor about the noise?
What was the result of leaving the note for the neighbor in Unit 4A?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: The most direct follow-up to asking about an action is to ask about its outcome.

user_needs.description: What are the official quiet hours for my apartment building?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Since the informal communication failed, the user's next logical step is to understand the official building rules before escalating.

user_needs.description: Who is the property management company and what is the property manager's name and email?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming the rules are being broken, the user needs to know who to report the violation to.

user_needs.description: What is my planned date for submitting a formal complaint to the property manager?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After identifying the contact for a formal complaint, the user will likely want to confirm their timeline for taking that action.

user_needs.description: What is the average weekly sleep disruption I've experienced from the noise?
When did my lease for Unit 4B begin?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After confirming the planned date for a formal complaint, the user may naturally want to gather a few key lease details to include as identifying context in that communication.
